title: Marco Leal re-interviews Carlos about 25 years later
summary: Carlos Dosoza tells of Marco Leal re-interviews Carlos about 25 years later, about c. 2021 at Sao Paulo, Brazil, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: "Wow, your account is exactly the same as the one you gave 25 years ago. Identical. Not a single detail has changed."

plain: Carlos Dosoza, a man in Sao Paulo, Brazil, tied to a claim that a hospital operated on a non-human being, told podcast host Jesse Michels that a researcher named Marco Leal interviewed him again around 2021, about 25 years after his first account. He says Leal told him his story was identical to the one he gave back then, with not a single detail changed. He tells it to show his account has stayed consistent over time.
